quotes.text: Time in the market beats timing the market.
Store through the plenty. Ration through the famine.
To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
A lifeboat is built in calm water.
No one builds the boat after the flood has started.
Patience is the only leverage that never gets liquidated.
The dreamer was laughed at until the famine came.
Plenty is not the time to spend. It is the time to store.
A key is only as safe as the hands that keep it.
The storm is not the test. The preparation is.
